g:
SAPIENS · LESSON 10 More power. But are we happier? <<<<<<< HEAD Our species gained enormous power, but did it make us happier?
STONE
ATOM ?

g.text: From a minor ape to master of the planet.
Maybe the most important question of all.
Happiness as chemistry inside the body.
Happiness: does reality match what we expect?
Billions of farm animals pay for our power.
BILLIONS OF FARM ANIMALS, NEEDS IGNORED
Measured by suffering, success looks far less impressive.
A Buddhist view of where suffering comes from.
No one yet knows which view is right.
Biotechnology could reshape our bodies and minds.
Harari’s challenge to a species with godlike power.
Powerful like gods, unsure where we’re heading.

g:
THINK OF ONE THING YOU ARE WORKING HARD TO GET Do you truly want it, or did a story teach you to want it?
WHAT DO YOU WANT TO WANT? ======= Godlike power, restless hearts, and the question of what we want.

g.text: From stone tools to the moon.
Did it make us happier? Not clearly.
Progress for the species, hardship for many.
Collective power does not mean individual joy.
Between our conditions and our expectations.
LIFE IMPROVES, THEN EXPECTATIONS CATCH UP
We keep running for more, yet feel about the same.
Mood is largely governed by serotonin and dopamine.
The boost fades. We drift back.
A Buddhist view explored by Harari.
Peace comes from understanding, not grabbing.
Biology, engineering and computers are converging.
Next, we may change what a human is.
We gain godlike powers, but rarely ask where we are going.
Power without purpose could take us anywhere.

g: NOT WHAT WE CAN BECOME, BUT WHAT WE WANT TO WANT Which of your wants would actually make you happier? ? ASK YOURSELF TODAY >>>>>>> 93ca47a (Draft 'Sapiens': lesson 10 of 10)
